summary: Greenfield URL shortener is ready for a first release: build and all tests pass, documentation is present, policy guardrails reported no violations, and the risk register items are mitigated or explicitly deferred.

checklist.item: Build succeeds with warnings as errors
Acceptance criteria AC1-AC8 each covered by at least one test
checklist.evidence: LinksApiTests maps one test per criterion

checklist.item: Policy guardrails (secrets, dangerous APIs, dependency allow-list)

checklist.evidence: README.md and CHANGELOG.md produced by the documentation stage
EnsureCreated in use; EF migrations deferred (documented)
DELETE is unauthenticated per assumption A1; revisit before public exposure

riskRegister.mitigation: Introduce EF Core migrations in the next iteration; EnsureCreated is documented as local-only.
Out of scope for v1; rate limiting is planned under the reliability work.
Scheme allow-list, private-host blocking; domain deny-lists can be added later.
EF Core abstraction keeps a PostgreSQL switch cheap.

rollbackPlan: Stop the service and redeploy the previous build; the SQLite file is forward-compatible because the schema only adds tables. For the orchestrated change itself, the workspace snapshot taken before implementation can be restored by the orchestrator.
knownLimitations: No analytics, no rate limiting, no authentication in this release.
Short URL host is derived from the request, not configurable yet.
